testimonials.text: Tammy has an incredible ability to make you feel at ease. Our wedding photos are absolutely breathtaking and perfectly capture the joy of our day.
testimonials.name: Sarah & James

faq.question: How do I book a session?
faq.answer: Simply call Tammy at 083 479 9732 or email letsmeet@tammyholliday.co.za to discuss your needs and schedule a date.

faq.question: What is the turnaround time for photos?
faq.answer: Editing and delivery times vary by service, but Tammy will provide a clear timeline during your consultation.

faq.question: What should we wear for our portrait session?
faq.answer: Tammy will provide a style guide and advice to help you coordinate outfits that look great on camera.
